question.problem: Show on a picture the displacement vector of a ship that travels $5\:\textrm{km}$ on a bearing of ${30}^{\circ}$.
question.worked_solution:
We choose an arbitrary point on the plane as the starting point (tail) of the vector. The vertical line shows the north direction.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14196310/assets/604ccf740830c570ee87731a719165cca75d615b3a4c8861d2671ccac95aad2e.png)

We go $30^\circ$ clockwise from the north.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14196310/assets/a370f5496c824619f0adf25caa219d4460e8bc491337d756c9ea1540b4d8223e.png)

The length of the line segment represents the distance traveled by the ship (which is $5\:\text{km}$).
